source: eucs-schedule.ultimatefederation.eu team card pages (per-club real rosters from various 2023-2026 EUCS Open events) + scores.frisbee.pl (Sky This, Uprising, AKS Zły — Mistrzostwa Polski OW 2024)
note: Real per-player names/jersey/games/assists/goals, transcribed from team card pages ('Punkty' on the frisbee.pl site = goals, 'Suma' = assists+goals total, matching the same schema). blocks/throwingYards/receivingYards are not tracked by either source and are estimated at load time (see eucsLeagueTeams.js). Teams not found on the source after reasonable search (notFound:true) fall back to procedural rosters. Krzysztof Zając is deliberately omitted from eucs-aks-zly's roster (kept only on eucs-wall-city) — same real player listed on both source pages.
